name: Amit Waisel
biography: Amit Waisel is a Senior Technical Leader at XM Cyber. He is a seasoned data security expert with vast experience in cyber offensive projects. Prior to XM Cyber, Amit filled multiple data security positions in the Israeli intelligence community. Amit is well experienced with malware detection and analysis techniques, operating system internals and security-oriented software development. He graduated with honors from Tel Aviv University with a MSc. in Computer Science.
